title: Nonperturbative Dyson--Schwinger equations in QCD: a first approximation
summary: We consider a procedure for nonperturbative quantization based on an infinite system of nonperturbative Dyson--Schwinger equations. We propose a first approximation for truncating this infinite system of equations in the static case.
